journey.name: signin cold start
journey.description: Verifies that a sign-in link opened while Bitkit is not running waits visibly for the saved Pubky session and then opens the authorization sheet. Precondition: an unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled and a locally managed Pubky identity, and a requesting app that supplies a fresh pubkyauth://signin_grant URL with a reachable homeserver and relay. Android only: iOS does not register the raw pubkyauth scheme for OS link delivery.

actions.action: Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "<the prepared signin_grant URL>"
Unlock Bitkit with PIN or biometrics when prompted
Verify a toast with a spinner reads Loading Your Pubky Profile (screenshot; toasts are not in the layout)
Verify the toast stays until the authorization sheet opens
Verify the authorization sheet shows the requesting app and permissions
Tap Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and complete PIN or biometric approval when enabled
Verify the authorization success state is shown (id "PubkyAuthOK")
Verify the requesting app receives approval from the recorded public key
